description:
Quantify mitochondrial network morphology in a fluorescence microscopy image.

1. Open the raw image at `~/Fiji_Data/raw/mitochondria/mitochondria_raw.tif`.
2. Preprocess the image to enhance fine structures (e.g., Subtract Background, Enhance Contrast, or Unsharp Mask).
3. Create a binary segmentation (Threshold) isolating the mitochondrial network.
4. Measure shape descriptors: Run `Analyze Particles` to calculate Aspect Ratio (AR) and Form Factor (Circularity). Save these measurements to `~/Fiji_Data/results/mitochondria/shape_metrics.csv`.
5. Analyze network topology: Skeletonize the binary image (`Process > Binary > Skeletonize`) and run `Analyze Skeleton (2D/3D)`. Save the skeleton results table to `~/Fiji_Data/results/mitochondria/skeleton_metrics.csv`.
6. Save the labeled skeleton map image (the visualization of the skeleton) to `~/Fiji_Data/results/mitochondria/skeleton_map.png`.

Success requires valid CSV files with non-trivial data (Aspect Ratio > 1.5) and a skeleton visualization.
